name: Eric Gitangu
title: Software Engineer, Payments Platforms and Distributed Systems
subtitle: Backend, platform and security engineering for payment systems in Africa
tagline: Backend and platform engineer for payment systems that run in production
summary: Software engineer with 11 years in production systems across fintech, healthcare, energy access, logistics and application security. I currently own architecture and security for a multi-surface payments and mobility platform, a Mastercard partner, where I removed an authentication bypass, closed money-correctness defects, mapped the platform to payments compliance requirements, and built card and mobile money rails within PCI DSS scope. Before that I led platform and quality engineering for a pay-as-you-go solar company in seven African countries, founded an ML security company for medical device software, and led the team behind a digital addressing pilot with the Nairobi County Government. I design event-driven systems, plan for failure, instrument what I ship, and lead teams through review, mentoring and clear technical direction. TypeScript, Java, PHP, Python, Rust, Go and C#.
